about_bio: ZWrld (Zach Ikenberry, born October 21, 2004) is a singer-songwriter from Diagonal, Iowa, writing country songs about faith, loss, and the people who shaped him. He started out in hip-hop, releasing his debut project "Start of a New Life" in 2020. Raised on Juice WRLD, XXXTentacion, and Lil Peep, along with Fall Out Boy, Panic! At The Disco, and Imagine Dragons, he learned early that the most honest songs hit the hardest. That honesty led him to country. His Christian faith runs through all of it: songs about real struggles, hard roads, and the hope that gets you through. No matter the genre, ZWrld writes for anyone who's ever lost someone and kept going anyway.

latest_release.title: I Still Miss You
latest_release.blurb: A song about missing someone who's gone.
